caption:
​🚨 "I have an idea, but I can't code." -> INVALID.

​If you are still saying this in 2026, you aren't paying attention. The barrier to building software has completely collapsed.

​The New Reality:
Tools like Bolt.new, Lovable, and Cursor allow you to generate full-stack applications just by typing in plain English.
​You type: "Build a CRM for my dog walking business with a dashboard and payment integration."
​AI does: Writes the code, sets up the database, and deploys the website.
​The Shift:
You don't need to be a "Software Engineer" anymore. You just need to be a "Product Manager." Your job is to describe the vision; the AI's job is to write the syntax.
​If you have an idea today, you can have a prototype by tonight.

​💬 The Big Question: What is the "App Idea" you've been sitting on because you couldn't code? 👇
